findings.title: Renamed function without updating call sites
findings.body: The function was renamed from `readSensor` to `sampleSensor`, but the new name is not used consistently. The change introduces a mismatch between the function definition and its intended usage, which can lead to runtime errors if callers still use the old name. Update all call sites to use `sampleSensor`.

findings.title: Inconsistent naming with local convention
findings.body: The new function name `sampleSensor` deviates from the existing local convention of using `read` prefixes for sensor-related functions (e.g., `readSensor`). This inconsistency reduces code readability and maintainability. Align the function name with the local convention by renaming it to `readSensor`.

summary.problem: The function rename introduces a correctness issue and breaks local naming conventions.
summary.done_well: The function signature and implementation remain correct and consistent with the sensor data structure.
